categories.evidence: Labeled Fuzzing and modifies fuzz harness infrastructure in src/test/fuzz/ to support custom mutators and PSBT structure-aware mutation.
categories.rationale: Adds infrastructure for target-specific libFuzzer custom mutators and introduces structure-aware mutations for PSBT deserialization. As noted in the description, 'byte-level mutations rarely produce well-formed key-value maps... so most inputs are rejected early and the deeper per-field parsing is rarely reached,' making this a worthwhile coverage improvement that can be reviewed when interested.
